            values_cooling.append(float(row[2]))

answer = all(value >= hvac_setpoint_heating and value <= hvac_setpoint_cooling for value in values_heating) and all(value >= hvac_setpoint_heating and value <= hvac_setpoint_cooling for value in values_cooling)

answer
